svg.metadata: {"changes": "Isolate original race-route geometry; omit annotations, pit lanes, alternative routes, sectors, flags, backgrounds and white halo. Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "Firkin / Openclipart", "historicalApplicability": "Full 5.848 km GP loop from the final 2014-2018 F1 circuit drawing; matches 2020/2021 official Russia maps including the 18-corner shape. Not the earlier 2013 19-corner project drawing nor the short Sirius layout introduced after November 2023.", "license": "CC0-1.0", "licenseUrl": "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/", "page": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:F1_circuits_2014-2018_-_Sochi_Autodrom_(version_2).svg", "sourceSha256": "33ad3311edb988733ac08e450cec0a9ce60bea47b5daeaf281e8fcafd0a23b1f", "url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/57/F1_circuits_2014-2018_-_Sochi_Autodrom_%28version_2%29.svg"}
svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
